name: Firecrawl MCP Server
what: Firecrawl's official MCP server. It lets agents search the web, scrape pages into clean markdown or structured data, crawl and map sites, and interact with pages. There is a hosted endpoint and a local npx version, and it can point at a self-hosted Firecrawl. MIT licensed.
who: Vibe coders and researchers who need clean page content from many sites. The hosted keyless tier allows scrape, search and parse with rate limits; crawl, map and agent tools need a Firecrawl API key.

setup.text: Easiest: add the hosted server URL to your MCP client (keyless free tier, rate-limited):

For the full tool set, sign in with OAuth at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth, or keep the first URL and set an Authorization: Bearer header with your API key in the client's secret settings (never in the URL).
